compute_energy_from_embeddings: compute system-level energy from node embeddings using an energy block module and batch indices
compute_forces_from_energy: compute atomic forces as the negative gradient of energy with respect to atomic positions
compute_forces_and_stress: compute forces and stress tensor from energy gradients with respect to positions and unit cell vectors
compute_hessian_matrix: compute the Hessian matrix as the second derivative of energy with respect to atomic positions
reduce_node_to_system: reduce node-level values to system-level by summing over nodes in each system with graph parallel support
